user.title: 2GIS Friends
user.description: Open 2gis.ru, press F12 -> Network -> filter WS -> connection user/ws -> Headers -> Request URL, and copy the value of the token= parameter (40 hex characters).

reauth_confirm.title: Token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The 2GIS token is no longer accepted. Grab a fresh one the same way and paste it below.

abort.already_configured: This 2GIS account is already set up
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different 2GIS account

init.title: Coverage area
init.description: 2GIS only sends updates for friends inside a map viewport. The area is a square of this many degrees around your Home Assistant location (1 degree is roughly 111 km).
